selection_policy: Within the reviewed source set, select the latest available filing for each exact calendar annual period. Keep blocks and rejected older vintages for audit. EPS is already transformed; do not reapply eps_multiplier_to_2012_share_basis. Do not derive any share factor from overlap ratios.

corroborating_source.source_locator: Item 6 total diluted EPS and split footnote (c)
corroborating_source.observation: FY2010 selected data independently shows 2006 EPS 2.60 and 2007/2008/2009/2010 EPS 2.57/4.76/1.63/7.49 on the post-2008 split basis. This source is corroboration; it is not a separate input block.

limitations: A reviewed split-unit bridge is narrower than complete economic and price/share comparability. share_basis_verified remains false.

EPS uses total historical GAAP earnings, including discontinued operations, extraordinary items and accounting changes as presented. No constant-business, constant-accounting or pro-forma reconstruction is claimed.

Source figures were rounded to cents. Scaling a rounded old EPS can differ from later independently rounded or recomputed EPS; keep source precision and prefer the later reviewed vintage, not ratio-fit transformations.

For 2005, 9.97 times 0.25 gives 2.4925, 4.99 times 0.5 gives 2.495, and the newer reported amount is 2.50. The difference is not used to infer a split. No claim is made that rounding alone explains every cross-vintage difference.
This source set does not establish that every possible amendment or intervening disclosure was reviewed. All retained source filings predate the 2012 cutoff.
Fiscal years are January 1 through December 31. Historical annual rows do not replace or extend the current TTM anchor.
The prior 2001-2003 losses are retained; no missing values are imputed and no historical EPS is divided by the 2012 actual diluted weighted share count.

Reviewed overlap tolerances are limited to the named official split chains. Values outside those bounds or unresolved substantive accounting/context differences require review; this is not a general rounding exemption for other issuers.
